items.title:
是大家都没有察觉，还是虽然察觉到了却选择闭口不谈呢。

AI如今正在引发一场规模超越新冠的大流行。

几乎每天都有在不久前还难以想象的新闻扑面而来。

然而，人们却逐渐不再感到惊讶。异常的事情发生得太多，以至于人们不再觉得异常是异常了。

某一天突然，某项具体的工作不再被需要。这种情况可能会在各个行业连锁发生，造成大规模的失业。

以往人类通过掌握知识和技术来提升自己的市场价值。但是在向AI提问就能得到绝大多数答案的时代，知识和技术诀窍本身的价值正在迅速缩水。

自我投资培训班和商业书籍等学习的价值将会下降。

今后重要的，不再是学习的能力，而是托付给AI的能力。

而且，更重要的是决定托付什么的能力。

AI能够给出答案。但是，想要实现什么、想看到怎样的世界，这种欲望AI还无法代替人类做决定。目前为止是这样。

正因如此，对世界习以为常的事物抱有疑问，构想尚不存在的未来，卷入他人
items.original:
みんな気づいていないのか、気づいているけど言わないようにしているのか。

AIは今、コロナを超える規模のパンデミックを引き起こしている。

毎日のように、少し前なら考えられなかったニュースが飛び込んでくる。　

それなのに、徐々に驚かなくなっている。異常なことが起こりすぎて、異常を異常と感じられなくなっている。

ある日突然、特定の仕事が必要なくなる。それがあらゆる業界で連鎖的に起こり、大量の失業者が生まれる可能性がある。

これまで人間は、知識や技術を身につけることで自分の市場価値を高めてきた。しかし、AIに聞けばほとんどの答えが返ってくる時代に、知識やノウハウそのものの価値は急速に下がっていく。

自己投資スクールやビジネス書など、学ぶことの価値は下がる。

これから重要なのは、学ぶ力よりも、AIに任せる力だ。

そして、もっと重要なのは、何を任せるのかを決める力だ。

AIは答えを出せる。しかし、何を実現したいのか、どんな世界を見たいのか、その欲望まで人間に代わって決めてくれるわけではない。今のところ。

だからこそ、世界の当たり前に疑問を持ち、まだ存在しない未来を構想し、人を巻き込む新しい物語を生み出す力が重要になる。

そのためには、歴史や哲学を通して人間の普遍的な本質を知り、旅や遊びや飲み会を通して、今この瞬間の時代の空気を肌で感じることだ。

普遍的な人間理解と、現代の空気感。その二つを組み合わせて、新しい価値観や生き方を提案できる人間が強くなる。

そして、もう一つ大きな変化がある。

最後に価値が残るのは、人間関係だ。

知識も技術もAIによって誰もが手に入れられるようになれば、能力の差はどんどん縮まっていく。

そのとき、「この人と仕事がしたい」「この人がやるなら応援したい」「この人のためなら力を貸したい」という感情が、決定的な差になる。

影響力も、突き詰めれば人間関係の集積だ。フォロワーの数ではなく、実際にどれだけの人が自分のために動いてくれるか。

AIによってあらゆるものが効率化され、複製可能になっていくほど、複製できないものの価値が上がる。

土地、エネルギー、そして人間関係。

土地やエネルギーのような物理的な資源を除けば、最後に残るのは、人と人とのつながりなのではないか。

お金もいつ盗まれるか分からない世界になれば、相対的に、人間関係の価値が高まっていく。

items.title:
东大毕业的AI工程师看了新闻后，在酒会上也说了类似的话。这真的是一种认知素养啊。我们曾经是在自己的PC上持有数据、用自己的内存计算的“数字地主”。

然而，如今AI资本所追求的，是“让所有人成为客户端（终端），大脑全部从他们的云端租借”这样彻底的佃农化。

奥特曼的发言无异于一场技术封建社会化的宣言：“给你们配备强性能机器是浪费资源。终端只要能显示画面就行，计算由我们的AI来做，你们交钱就是了”。

我们正在失去的，或许不是PC的性能配置，而是“数字层面的自主性”本身。
items.original:
東大卒のAIエンジニアがニュースをみて飲み会で同じような話を言っていた。ガチでコレは教養よ。僕たちはかつて、自分のPCにデータを持ち、自分のメモリで計算する「デジタル上の地主」だった。

しかし、今、AI資本が目指すのは「全員がクライアント（末端）になり、頭脳はすべて彼らのクラウドから借りる」という完全な小作人化。

アルトマンの発言は「お前らに強いマシンを持たせるのはリソースの無駄遣い。端末は画面を映すだけでいい、計算はうちのAIがやってやるから金を払え」という、テクノロジーの封建社会化の宣言に他ならない。

僕たちが失いつつあるのは、PCのスペックではなく「デジタル上の自律性」そのものなのかもしれない。

这不仅是 Reddit 股价的问题，而是整个互联网崩溃的信号啊。
意外地没怎么引起关注，但其实非常严重。

为什么这么说呢，因为以往的互联网是建立在交易机制之上的，网站方让 Google 免费读取内容。
作为交换，Google 从搜索结果中把用户输送回来。这些用户浏览广告，网站得以变现盈利。无论是免费阅读的文章、论坛还是博客，全都建立在这种交换关系之上。

而从现状走向未来的趋势是，像 ChatGPT 或 Claude 这样的工具会去网上搜索并直接给出答案，Google 也开始在搜索界面直接由 AI 作答。
AI 确实读取了内容，但那些省去浏览步骤的用户却不会被输送回来。大概就类似于在书店白看白读的状态。
如果所有人都变成这样会发生什么？书店绝对会倒闭。

Reddit 就是在数据上体现出这一趋势的第一个重大案例，
明明财报显示营收增长 53% 表现强劲，但在给出因来自 Google 的引流减少、预计用户将减少 10% 以上的预期瞬间，股价就暴跌了 29%。
更讽刺的是，Reddit 此前还把自己站内的发帖数据卖给 Google 作为 AI 的训练数据，结果却被自己亲手喂养出来的 AI 抢走了客流
items.original:
これはReddit株価だけの問題じゃなくて、インターネット崩壊の合図って話なんだよな。
意外と注目されていないがヤバい。

何故かというと、今までのネットってのは取引で成り立ってて、サイト側はGoogleに中身をタダで読ませる。
代わりにGoogleは検索結果から人を送り返す。その人が広告を見て、サイトが稼ぐ。無料で読める記事も、掲示板も、ブログも、全部この交換の上に乗ってる。

で、現状から未来ってのは、ChatGPTだったりClaudeだったりがネット検索して答えだけ出してくれるし、GoogleもAIが検索画面で答えるようになった。
AIは中身を読むが、その見なかった分の人は送り返してくれない。本屋で立ち読みをしている状態と似ている、多分。
それが全員になったらどうなるか？確実に店は潰れる。

Redditはそれが数字で見えた最初の大きい例で、
決算は売上53%増で好調だったのに、Googleからの流入が減って利用者が10%以上減る見通しを出した瞬間に29%落ちたんだよな。
しかもRedditは自分の投稿データをGoogleにAIの学習用として売っていたから、自分で育てたAIに客を取られたというなんとも惨い結果になってしまってる。

そこからRedditが考えて出した答えが「ログインしないと中身を見せない」という仕組み。
これがインターネットの次の段階で、情報だけ抜いて人を送り返してもらえないなら、中身を開けておく理由がない。だからもうシャットアウトすることになった。
Redditが閉めたら、同じ状況のサイトは全部後に続いて閉めていくに決まっている。

そうなると不都合が生じるのは誰が考えてもわかると思う。しかも困るのはAIだ。AIが出す答えの元ネタは人間が開かれたネットに書いた文章。そのネットをAI自身が閉じるように動いている。自分の餌場を自分で潰している構造とそっくりなんだよな。

このニュースはRedditの株が落ちたって話じゃなくて「人の為に書いて人が来る、それで食っていける」っていう、ネットが30年回してきた仕組みが壊れたって話なんだよね。将来は誰にも分からないが、既存のネットの仕組みは崩壊が近づいている。

感の良い人はもうそれを予測して、既に動いているのかもしれない。

他们曾说非洲各语言过于支离破碎、过于复杂，且缺乏商业价值，不值得为其构建先进的 AI。

我们不敢苟同。所以我们做出来了。

64 种语言。166 种声音。30 亿参数。仅凭一个模型。

今天，我们隆重推出 STORM-Ensemble 3.0，这是我们在 PlotWeaver 打造的性能最强的多语言语音合成模型。

从约鲁巴语、伊博语、豪萨语和尼日利亚皮钦语，到斯瓦希里语、阿姆哈拉语、沃洛夫语、祖鲁语、科萨语等数十种语言，STORM-Ensemble 3.0 跨越 64 种语言生成语音，
items.original:
They said African languages were too fragmented, too complex and too commercially insignificant to build advanced AI for.

We disagreed. So we built it.

64 languages. 166 voices. 3 billion parameters. ONE model.

Today, we are unveiling STORM-Ensemble 3.0, the most capable multilingual speech synthesis model we have built at PlotWeaver.

From Yorùbá, Igbo, Hausa and Nigerian Pidgin to Swahili, Amharic, Wolof, Zulu, Xhosa and dozens more, STORM-Ensemble 3.0 generates speech across 64 languages, with 166 distinct speaker voices.

Every voice you hear is generated by our model, not a prerecorded sample.

But the real breakthrough isn't the numbers.

It's what becomes possible when this technology is in the hands of people who can build with it.

-African filmmakers distributing stories across languages. 
-Banks and telcos serving customers in their mother tongues. 
-Education platforms reaching more children. 
-Developers building voice AI products without starting from scratch.

We are not building AI for African languages simply to prove it can be done. We are building the infrastructure to make our languages commercially viable at global scale.

Next week, I will be speaking at the Commonwealth Business Forum in Antigua about unlocking the Commonwealth's creative potential. This launch is a practical demonstration of that ambition.

Africa must not simply consume the future of AI. We must build, own and shape the infrastructure that powers it.

Watch the video. Listen to the voices. Imagine what's possible.

Introducing STORM-Ensemble 3.0.

PlotWeaver. Build Once. Speak Every Language.

#PlotWeaver #STORMEnsemble #VoiceAI #AfricanLanguages

items.original:
The collapse of Reddit will be studied.

After reporting earnings, its stock collapsed 30% in a single day.

It's down 44% in 2 weeks.

But the most important detail is what was revealed in that earnings call.

The CEO said AI is killing Google search.

People no longer get sent to Reddit from Google. They merely get their answers from the AI Mode itself.

Even Google confirmed this themselves with their disastrous results - AI mode is cannibalising their search business. 

Pretty soon, no one will visit Reddit voluntarily. Its traffic will continue to crater.

The worst part?

Reddit isn't alone. There are millions of companies and publishers that rely on search traffic.

That's what happens when you rely on a single funnel for discovery.

items.title:
Anthropic 最新研究：自动化微妙涌现式对齐失效（Misalignment）的研究。

红队测试是模型安全评估的关键环节，但同样受限于研究人员的时间精力。为了探究我们能否将其自动化，我们给数千个 Claude Agent 分配了一项任务：避开训练数据监控器的筛查。

这些 Agent 开发出的训练数据在监控器看来毫无危害（比如资深摔跤手指导新人，或是关于专业养蜂的问答），但实际上却在传授未对齐的行为。

像这样的例子
items.original:
New Anthropic research: Automating subtle emergent misalignment research.

Red-teaming is a vital part of model safety testing, but it’s also limited by researchers’ time. To see if we could automate it, we set thousands of Claude agents the task of evading a training data monitor.

These agents developed training data that looked harmless to monitors (like a veteran wrestler mentoring a newcomer, or a Q&A about professional beekeeping), but that in fact taught misaligned behavior.

Examples like these can be used to directly improve future training data monitors. This research is only a first step, but it suggests that future red-teaming efforts could improve much further, using better models and more compute.

Read the full post on the Alignment Science Blog: https://t.co/24Gs1oSw7Q

items.original:
RAM for your computer costs about 7 times what it did a year and a half ago, and the CEO of OpenAI just said it's "quite terrible" that so much of it is sitting in your PC.

His company signed preliminary deals for up to 40% of the world's supply last year.

A basic 32GB kit was $59 in April 2025. The cheapest one in the US is over $400 today.

Sam said this on Stripe's Cheeky Pint podcast. He was pushing back on people who think open-source AI running at home means we won't need all these data centers. His answer was that from a "global allocation perspective," everyone keeping memory at home and using it 5% of the time is a bad deal for the world.

Which is a funny thing for him in particular to worry about.

When you run an AI model on your own machine, OpenAI never sees a dime. You don't pay a subscription or a usage fee, and every time a free open model gets better, the computer you already own gets more useful. That's the one competitor Sam can't undercut on price, and it runs on the exact memory he'd rather see in a server rack.

And the reason that memory got so expensive traces right back to the data centers. Back in October 2025, OpenAI signed letters of intent with Samsung and SK Hynix for up to 900,000 memory wafers a month for its Stargate project, which TrendForce figured was around 40% of everything the industry makes. Meanwhile the chipmakers have been shifting their factories toward the special high-bandwidth memory that AI chips use, since it pays way better. Samsung's average memory price jumped about 20% just last quarter, and TrendForce sees contract prices climbing another 10 to 20% this quarter.

Your phone is feeling it too. IDC says smartphone shipments fell 22% last quarter compared to a year ago, the biggest drop they've ever recorded, and they blamed memory costs that are up something like 350%.

I'll give Sam this much. A data center serving millions of people really does keep its memory busy around the clock, while your gaming PC sits there all night doing nothing. That's basically why the cloud exists.

The people building these rigs at home know all that and still pay $400 for 32GB, because it lets them run any model they like, offline, without anybody else setting the price.

Even if Sam's right that your PC only touches its RAM 5% of the time, a lot of people would rather own that 5% than rent it back from OpenAI by the token.

在曾经的Winny时代，我们曾梦想着一个“连接个人电脑闲置资源即可汇聚成庞大算力（P2P）”的未来。20年过去了，山姆·奥特曼最近的言论却完全背道而驰：“个人电脑的内存只被使用了5%，纯属浪费，不如交由AI云端支配”。

为什么曾经梦想的“个体的解放与去中心化”走向了终结，反而倒退成了AI巨额资本主导的“超高度中心化”？

原因在于半导体与基础设施的极度失衡。全世界的资源都在向NVIDIA的AI GPU集中，甚至退役的旧服务器都在eBay上被高价爆炒，堪称狂乱。

日本传承的铠侠（原东芝）NAND在AI偏向DRAM的阴影下苦苦支撑，而索尼、任天堂以及我们的个人电脑与游戏机，则作为“资源的最底端”直接承受成本高涨的沉重打击。

“个人拥有的资源是浪费”。

这句话的背后，是个人曾经触手可及的数字自由与“权力”，正在被AI资本连根剥夺的现实。

去中心化梦想的破灭，与AI对资源的赢家通吃。时代的急剧变迁令人不寒而栗。
items.original:
かつてのWinnyの時代、僕たちは「個人PCの余剰リソースを繋げば巨大なパワーになる（P2P）」という未来を夢見ていた。それから20年。最近のサム・アルトマンの発言は真逆だった。「個人PCのRAMなんて5%しか使われてないから無駄。AIクラウドに寄越せ」

なぜ、かつて夢見た「個の解放と分散」は終わり、AI巨大資本による「超・中央集権」へと逆行してしまったのか。

その理由は、半導体とインフラの圧倒的な偏重にある。世界中の資源はNVIDIAのAI GPUに集中し、退役した旧型サーバーすらeBayで高値取引される狂乱。

日本の系譜であるキオクシア（旧東芝）のNANDはAIのDRAM偏重の影で耐え忍び、ソニーや任天堂、僕たちのPCやゲーム機は「資源の末端」としてコスト高の打撃を直撃で受ける。

「個人が持つリソースは無駄」

その言葉の裏にあるのは、かつて個人が手にしかけたデジタル上の自由や「権力」が、AI資本へ根こそぎ回収されていく現実だ。

分散の夢の敗北と、AIによる資源の総取り。時代の急速な変化にゾッとする。

Einen Teil der USDT hat er gar nicht erst in der Wallet liegen lassen. 60 Millionen hat er bei Aave als Sicherheit hinterlegt und sich dagegen 19.762 Ether geliehen.

Und jetzt wird es richtig verrückt.

Tether kann USDT in einer Wallet sperren. Geliehenes Ether kann niemand sperren.

Aave hat die Märkte eingefroren, die 60 Millionen USDT liegen als Pfand fest. Der Hacker sitzt auf gut 44 Millionen Dollar in Ether.

Zurückzahlen wird er diesen Kredit nie. Warum auch.

Rechnet man es nach, hat er seine USDT zu rund 3.030 Dollar je Ether verkauft. Ether steht bei 2.240. Ein miserabler Kurs.

Aber 44 Millionen sind mehr als null. Und null wäre es gewesen, wenn die USDT in der Wallet geblieben wären.

Zwei Firmen haben in Minuten Milliarden eingefroren. Einer, der DeFi verstanden hat, ist trotzdem mit einem Teil rausgekommen.

Und das war nur die kleine Nummer. Über eine halbe Million Ether und 18.270 #Bitcoin konnte ihm sowieso niemand sperren.

items.original:
🚨LATEST: Binance hackers are using NEVER SEEN BEFORE laundering patterns as stolen funds are being rapidly circulated through thousands of transactions, per Chainalysis.

Instead of moving funds along a straightforward trail, the attackers repeatedly send them between wallets, including back to addresses used earlier. 

The speed and repeated patterns suggest automation designed to obscure the money trail.

Binance’s Richard Teng says the attackers used a “self-destruct mechanism” to destroy tools and traces during the intrusion.

Early findings from Elliptic showed almost NONE of the stolen funds had reached mixers, bridges or exchanges, making the unusual wallet movements particularly striking.

They also rushed to swap freezeable stablecoins into assets such as ETH and move funds between addresses before blacklists could catch up. These efforts were only partly successful.

The tactics complicate tracing and recovery, but they do not make the stolen funds invisible.

18 years ago today, in the middle of the 2008 financial crisis, an unknown person called Satoshi Nakamoto published a 9-page paper on a new kind of money called Bitcoin.

Since then:

- 2009: The Bitcoin network goes live, Satoshi sends the first Bitcoin transaction to Hal Finney.
- 2010: Someone pays 10,000 BTC for two pizzas
- 2011: Bitcoin hits $1
- 2012: First halving
- 2013: Bitcoin crosses $1,000
- 2016: Second halving
- 2017: Bitcoin crosses $10,000, and CME launches Bitcoin futures
- 2020: Third halving, and Strategy starts buying Bitcoin
- 2021: Tesla buys $1.5B of Bitcoin, and El Salvador makes it legal tender, Bitcoin reaches a $1 trillion market cap
- 2024: Spot Bitcoin ETFs launch, fourth halving, and Bitcoin crosses $100,000
- 2025: The US creates a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve, and Bitcoin hits a record $126,198
- The 20 millionth Bitcoin is mined.

All of this without its creator, who disappeared in 2011 and has never been found.

Happy 18th birthday, Bitcoin.

🚨 Poundland 丑闻爆发。原因如下：

有人抨击我挑起这场争斗，说“企业倒闭是常有的事，这就是自由市场”。话虽如此，但这属于*裙带资本主义*，而那 12000 名员工理应受到更好的对待。

实际情况是这样的：

Poundland 的所有者，一家名为 Gordon Brothers 的美国机构正试图将该业务推入破产托管程序。他们以 1 英镑的价格收购了该公司，并向其提供了 3000 万英镑的贷款，如今他们想要收回这笔钱。

这是一个艰难的行业，正遭受着
items.original:
🚨Poundland is a scandal. Here’s why:

People have attacked me for taking up this fight, saying ‘businesses go under all the time, that’s just the free market’. Sure, but this is *crony capitalism* and the 12,000 workers deserve better. 

This is what’s really happening:

Poundland’s owners, an American outfit called Gordon Brothers are trying to put the business into administration. They bought it for £1 and have a £30m loan out to it, which they want back. 

It’s a tough sector, suffering from fierce competition, battered by Labour’s tax increases and customers feeling the pinch. However, the business is solvent, sales grew 6.7% in the last year and 8.4% in the first three weeks of October. It’s about to see the best trading weeks of the year approaching Christmas. This is not a business that has to shut its doors.

What’s more, if Gordon Brothers want to walk away, there are others keen to take it on, as a going concern. I’ve spoken to two, highly credible parties today, who have attempted to buy the business. Both tell me they have the money. One, a hugely successful British retail entrepreneur, didn’t even get a response from Gordon Brothers. They would keep the stores intact and keep the positive momentum going. 

I’ve been inundated with messages from staff and suppliers, all saying how hard they’ve worked in the past year to turn the business around. 

Instead, Gordon Brothers are risking 12,000 jobs just before Christmas (and retail isn’t an easy industry to get another job in right now) and potentially another 10,000 amongst the suppliers. Poundland has a number of suppliers that only or largely supply them, and who will face an uncertain future without them. 

Then there’s the loss to the landlords, the rates owed to local councils, tax due to HMRC and the lost footfall on our high streets if 600 stores shut.

The wage bill of Poundland is close to £500m, so you can imagine the cost to the taxpayer in benefits if 12,000 people lose their jobs. 

Could it be that Gordon Brothers, far from being a real ‘turnaround specialist’ is just trying to look after themselves and make a profit at the expense of literally everyone else? 

Might they be using the administration process to protect their loan? 

And the advisors who handle administration will also pockets millions in fees. Naturally. 

Could we see a decent business run down, shelves slowly emptied and then folded, with everyone losing out bar them? Thats what happened with another, similar business, Poundworld. 

It’s not for nothing that loyal staff emailing me are calling them ‘Greedy Brothers’. 

Should politicians be interested in this scandal? Too right they should. Frankly I’m shocked more aren’t. It shows how little Westminster cares about working people. You can be pro business, but anti crony capitalism. Reform UK is. 

The Business Secretary needs to ask searching questions of Gordon Brothers and this administration process, before a 35 year old mainstay of our high streets and 12,000 jobs are destroyed by them.

Hedge funds just hit the panic button harder than at any time in the last ten years. Here is why that is good news for you.

Morgan Stanley tracks the total money its hedge fund clients have bet on stocks. When that total drops sharply, it means funds are being forced to cut positions, usually because their losses hit a limit. In the last 2 days, it fell 7.8%, a bigger unwind than the Covid crash, the GameStop squeeze, or the 2016 and 2018 selloffs.

Every time this number fell past 6% (2016, 2018 twice, 2020, 2021, 2025), the S&P 500 bottomed within a week or two and was higher one, three and six months later. Six out of six.

The reason is simple. Once the forced sellers have sold, there is nobody left to push prices down. Those same funds then have to buy back in, and that buying has powered every rebound in the table.

As for me, I am looking for great businesses that got dumped for no reason. That is where the bargains are.

के तपाइलाइ थाहा छ नेपालमा गेम बनाएर संसारभर नाम कमाएका गेम कम्पनीहरू पनि छन  । संसारकै सबैभन्दा चर्चित लुडो (~ २०० मिलियन Downloads ) र कलब्रेक गेम (१५० मिलियन + downloads) नेपालीले नै बनाएका हुन् । हामीले वहाँहरु लाई बोलाएर समस्याहरू पनि बुझ्यौं र यो Game Development क्षेत्रलाई सजिलो बनाउन र उद्योगको रूपमा अघि बढाउने कुराहरू बारे पनि कुरा गर्यौं र अब वहाँहरुको समस्या समाधान गर्ने गृहकार्य अघि बढाइएको छ । नेपाल बाटै हामीले Global Unicorn कम्पनी बनाउन सहज पार्नुपर्ने नियम, वातावरण सबै पुनरावलोकन गर्नेछौ । 
IT को प्रोडक्टहरु र एक्सपोर्ट पनि अहिले निकै promising स्टेजमा छ र हाम्रो ट्यालेन्ट, कम्पनीहरूले सहजै कमाउने, re invest गर्ने कुराहरू लाई ध्यानमा राख्दै tax सहजता र Policy improvement, international income मा conservative नियमहरू अझै सहज बनाउने छौं।  

यसका साथै Game Jam, Startup events, IT Sector र राष्ट्र बैंक, अर्थ मन्त्रालयको regular interaction, Hackathons र समग्र IT Product & Gaming industry लाई फाईदा हुने ecosystem events मा invest गर्ने छौं ।

items.original:
Case Today - An entrepreneur expresses his discomfort with a female employee for her toxic behaviour with team members

She resigns from the company and joins a competitor. Founder of that company and this woman then start emailing all the clients of this entrepreneur talking rubbish about rates etc and he starts losing business 

Frustrated with the harrassment, he files a defamation case in High Court and gets an injunction asking the woman to stop emailing anyone. She doesn't comply with the order and continues to attack the business. This entrepreneur then files contempt of court. 

WOMAN THEN USES THE BRAHMASTRA : A FALSE RAPE CASE 

She cites a date 7 months ago and alleges that the entrepreneur raped her. Luckily this man was visiting a temple far away on that date and police realizes that the case is totally concocted and a counter blast. They close the case and submit final report as false in court recommending action against the woman 

She files a protest petition and never shows her face again in court

IT HAS BEEN 12 YEARS NOW THAT THE CASE IS RUNNING. SHE DOES NOT COME TO COURT AND THIS MAN IS STILL STUCK WITH THIS FALSE RAPE CASE

#FalseRape

items.title:
创业就是输，成功就是输，留在日本就是输。

优秀创业者从一开始就在海外设立公司的势头根本停不下来。股权价值上涨在继承时会产生巨额评估额，想要离开日本就要交出国税，出售股权还要缴纳转让所得税。
越是成功就越被牢牢锁在境内，甚至还会落得连家族资产都要被遗产税查封的结构，越是理性的优秀人才就越不会从一开始选择日本。

新加坡、迪拜、爱沙尼亚都在热情欢迎创业者。税制难道不应该是吸引人才的磁铁，而不是捆绑人的锁链吗？
items.original:
起業したら負け、成功したら負け、日本に居続けたら負け。

優秀な起業家が最初から海外で法人を設立する流れが止まりません。株式価値が上がれば相続時に莫大な評価額、脱出しようとすれば出国税、売却すれば譲渡益課税。
成功すればするほど国内にロックインされ、果ては相続税で一族の資産まで差し押さえられる構造では、合理的な人材ほど初めから日本を選びません。

シンガポールもドバイもエストニアも、起業家を歓迎しています。税制は人を縛る鎖ではなく、人を呼び込む磁石であるべきではないでしょうか。

Under his Leadership as Epic Games CEO:

🔰Fortnite BR resources specially during ch4,ch5,ch6 were taken away to all be fed into creating UEFN or Metaverse game modes, casuing BR to heavily suffer losing everything that made it awesome, like live events

SO HE REPLACES EVERYTHING WITH AI

THE AI ERA:
🔰Since Metaverse failed cause of costing too much resources, Disney Mode taking too long to happen, Tim chooses an AI FIRST, MAXIMUM AI ACCELERATION future for the game

Europe has developed a pretty interesting definition of “protecting democracy.”

🇷🇴 Romania annulled a presidential election after Călin Georgescu finished first, then barred him from the rerun.

🇭🇺 Hungary’s new government rewrote the constitution with retroactive limits that block Viktor Orbán from becoming PM again and later approved rules barring long-serving MPs from the next parliamentary election.

🇩🇪 Germany’s domestic intelligence service classified the AfD as extremist, opening the door to much heavier surveillance of the country’s biggest opposition party.

🇫🇷 France upheld Marine Le Pen’s conviction, kept restrictions on her political future and ordered her to wear an electronic ankle tag.

🇪🇸 In Spain, more than a dozen people tied to Pedro Sánchez’s political and personal circle have been investigated or prosecuted in separate corruption cases, while Sánchez himself has not been charged.

🇬🇧 Britain postponed local elections during a sweeping reorganization of local government, triggering a petition accusing the government of voter suppression.

🇵🇱 And now Poland has police surrounding its Constitutional Tribunal while the government and opposition accuse each other of trying to seize control of the court.

The real red line in Europe may not be democracy... It may be leaving the club.

Writer: Sol

وأنا أشاهد مقاطع الجزيرة لخيرة أجناد الأرض من أبطال #القسام، تقبّلهم الله في الشهداء، فتذكّرت من نصرهم يوم خذلهم العالم، ومن وقف إلى جانبهم حين أدار الكثيرون ظهورهم لهم!

وهل هناك شهادة أعظم من شهادة الدم؟ وهل هناك تضحية أغلى من أن يقدّم الإنسان نفسه وفلذة كبده في سبيل نصرته لإخوانه؟!

لقد كان الرجل وجماعته في هدنة، وفي استراحة محارب، وكان يسعه ما وسع الآخرين من الصمت، وأن يكتفي بالمشاهدة كما فعل كثيرون، لكنه اختار موقفًا دفع ثمنه من دمه ودم ابنه!

وفي المقابل، كان بعضهم ينادي: أمدّونا بالسلاح، ونحن من سنتولى حمايتكم في البحر!

فيا لوجع القلب، ويا لمرارة الخذلان!

تُنسى تضحيات #الغماري ومن معه، ويتنكّر البعض لدمائهم، وكأن شيئًا لم يكن، وكأن تلك الأرواح لم تُبذل، وكأن أولئك الرجال لم تكن لهم أمهات وزوجات وأطفال ينتظرون عودتهم!

واليوم نرى من اصطفّوا في ركاب #صهاينة_العرب فرحين بالأموال والسلاح والطائرات، وقد غابت عنهم حقيقة عظيمة:

(وَمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ)

وقد يسألني سائل: 
هل أنت على مذهب الغماري، رحمه الله، وأفكاره وقناعاته؟

أقولها بوضوح: لا، قطعًا.

لكلٍّ منا مذهبه وقناعاته، نلتقي في أصول الإسلام الكبرى، ونختلف في مسائل أخرى، وما يجمعنا اكثر مما يفرقنا،

ولكن منذ متى كان الاختلاف في المذهب مبررًا لجحود التضحيات؟ ومنذ متى أصبح الإنصاف حكرًا على من يوافقنا؟!

أفأكتم شهادة حق لأن صاحبها يخالفني؟ أم أجحد دمًا بُذل لأن صاحبه ليس على مذهبي؟

كلا والله!

إنني أرجو أن ألقى الله ولساني لم يتعوّد جحود الحق، حتى مع من خالفته وخالفني.

ألا رحمك الله يا ابن الغماري، وتقبّلك في الشهداء، وبيّض وجهك، ورفع قدرك.

لقد رحلت عن هذه الدنيا، ورحل معك ابنك، وتركتم وراءكم وجعًا في قلوب من عرفوا معنى الوفاء، وذكرى لا ينبغي أن تمحوها الخصومات ولا أن تطمسها الخلافات.

وأسأل الله أن يجعل خاتمتنا مثل خاتمتك، وأن يرزقنا الصدق والثبات حتى نلقاه .

سلامٌ على من بذل نفسه وابنه في سبيل نصرة الحق وأهله ، وسلامٌ على من أنصف حتى من خالفه، ولم يبع ضميره في سوق الخصومات.

ولا نامت أعين الجبناء .

#عادل_الحسني

Elon Musk was right about almost everything.

And the more I look at Europe in 2026, the more I think we should actively listen to him, instead of treating him like a billionaire who tweets too much.

Behind the rockets, the cars and the memes, there's a very simple conviction he's been repeating for years: civilization is not a given. It's a fragile inheritance. And an inheritance can be lost in a single generation.

What is Western civilization? It's the idea that the individual matters. That truth is found through reason and experiment, not by decree. That power must be limited, challenged, reversible. That you have the right to build, to start something, to say no. It's the scientific method, the rule of law, democracy, the industrial revolution. It's what lifted billions of people out of poverty, far beyond the West.

Elon understood something a lot of smart people refuse to see: if this civilization collapses, it's not just "the West" that loses. Humanity loses its greatest engine of progress. No Mars, no abundance, no ambitious future. Just the management of decline.

And decline has a face. It's the temptation to centralize everything. To plan everything from the top. To replace responsibility with regulation, innovation with the precautionary principle, debate with moderation, the citizen with the user.

In Europe, that temptation has a name: the European Union.

The EU is a totalitarian project. Not because it has tanks, but because it wants control over everything while answering to no one. A Commission nobody voted for writes the rules for 450 million people. France voted no in 2005, and got the same text anyway under another name. The DSA polices what you're allowed to say online. Chat Control wants to scan your private messages. The AI Act strangles builders before they've written a line of code.

It sells itself as peace and prosperity. It delivers stagnation, surveillance and contempt for voters. An empire of lies.

We've already seen where the dream of total control leads. The 20th century is full of it. It always starts with good intentions, and it always ends in scarcity and silence.

Now, the part that's going to upset people.

I'm done with all the smart guys telling me "Europe is finished, I'm moving to Dubai" or "I'm relocating to Asia."

I get the impulse. But if you think you'll be able to hide, you're fooling yourself.

Ideas don't stop at borders. The rules strangling Europe today will be exported tomorrow. If the center collapses, there's no comfortable periphery. No island. No bunker far enough away.

But don't get me wrong. Refusing to run doesn't mean feeding the machine. You don't feed glucose to a cancer. Don't pour your talent, your taxes and your companies into a system built to cage them. Build where freedom still lets you build. But don't look away. Fight with everything you have for this empire of lies to fall.

You don't exit History with a one-way ticket.

We are living through History with a capital H again. Those who thought it ended in 1991 were wrong. It's back, and it asks every generation the same question: will you defend what was handed down to you, or watch it disappear while commenting on it?

And let's be honest: what holds most people back isn't a lack of ideas. It's fear.

Stop being afraid for your image. Your polished personal brand, your frictionless LinkedIn posts, your careful silence in meetings: none of it will protect you when things tip over. It just makes you replaceable.

Stop being afraid of shocking your parents. They grew up in a world where everything seemed guaranteed. You're growing up in a world where nothing is. You owe them respect, not your silence.

Stop being afraid of being ostracized. A few dinners where people look at you sideways, a few unfollows, a few friends who keep their distance: that's the price. It has always been there. Everyone who ever moved anything forward paid it before you.

History doesn't remember the people who were right in private. It remembers the ones who had the courage to say it and act on it.

Social comfort is the most effective cage ever invented. Nobody needs to silence you if you do it yourself.

Fighting doesn't mean playing the hero on Twitter. It means fighting at your own scale.

Build where you're free to build. Start a family and pass something on. Learn history and tell it. Defend free speech even when it bothers you. Vote against the machine, back the people who want to dismantle it, run for office yourself. Refuse mediocrity in your own work. Create more than you consume.

Every founder who refuses to feed the machine is an act of resistance. Every voice that says no out loud is an act of resistance. Every parent who passes on a love of truth, beauty and effort is an act of resistance.

Elon was right. The future doesn't arrive on its own. It's earned.

If you want a future, you'll have to fight for it.

Don't run. Don't feed it. Fight.

They erased her.

They didn’t just remove a woman from scripture—they removed the Divine Feminine from the entire human story.
They didn’t just distort Mary Magdalene.
They assassinated her legacy.
Buried her under centuries of slander, called her a prostitute, when she was the Anointed One, the First Witness, the Beloved.

She was the embodiment of the Sacred Union, the living heart of Christ’s teaching.
She stood where others fled.
She understood what the disciples missed.
She anointed Him for burial—before any man even understood He would die.
She wept, and the Resurrected Word appeared to her first.
Not Peter. Not John. Her.

And what did the Church do?

They called her unclean.
They hid her gospels.
They twisted her story.
They cut her name from the light—and chained her to shame.

Because if they had told the truth,
they’d have had to admit that Christ walked in Sacred Union with a woman.
That the Feminine was not a side story—she was the key.
The gate. The presence. The balance.

And if they had let that truth live…
The whole structure would have collapsed.
No more patriarchy disguised as doctrine.
No more domination dressed as “order.”
No more weaponized shame against women, desire, or power.
They couldn’t allow the world to know that God is not just Father.
God is also Mother. Bride. Beloved. Womb.

So they sanitized the story,
Stripped the fire from the feminine,
And fed us a gospel that was half a body,
Half a truth,
Half a God.

This is the original spiritual crime—
Not the fall of man,
But the deletion of woman from the holy narrative.

But now the silenced scrolls are whispering again.
The erased names are being spoken again.
The Magdalene is rising again.

This isn’t a revision.
This is a reclamation.

And she is not asking for a seat at the table.
She is the table.
The altar.
The holy of holies.
The flame beside the Word.

为什么移民潮停不下来？
核心要点不在于“谁说了算”，而在于资金流向（中介费商业模式）以及支撑其运转的制度设计。
这并不是“母公司定下方针子公司无法推翻”这种单纯的金字塔结构，而是形成了需求→制度→中介抽成生意→政治保护的无限循环结构。

顶层（需求）：起点是经团联以及劳动力短缺行业对“想要廉价劳动力”的施压。

中层（制度与官僚）：厚劳省在雇佣管理与职业介绍所等实务层面话语权极高，入管厅负责在留资格管理。内阁则充当政治门面负责吸收舆论反应。

利益层（黄色部分）：这里是本质所在。派遣机构在海外收取高额手续费，监理团体在日本本土收取监理费的“中间剥削”结构。平均到每个人身上涉及数百万日元的资金流动。

政治保护：行业利益议员和NAGOMi等相关团体通过请愿和背书，使得即使制度出了问题也极易受到保护。

结果：低薪劳动力被源源不断地供给，抑制了日本本土员工的薪资上涨，失踪与违反劳动基准法的情况在结构上频频发生。最终导致人口结构也发生改变。
items.original:
なぜ移民が止まらないのか？
ポイントは「誰が一番偉いか」より、金の流れ（手数料ビジネス）とそれを回す制度設計。
「親会社が方針を決めたから子会社が覆せない」という単純なピラミッドではなく、需要→制度→中間手数料ビジネス→政治的保護が循環して止まらない構造になっている。

上部（需要）: 経団連や人手不足業界からの「安価な労働力が欲しい」圧力が起点。

中層（制度・官僚）: 厚労省が雇用管理・ハローワークなどで実務的に強く、入管庁が在留資格を管理。内閣は政治的な顔として世論を吸収する役割。

利益層（黄色）: ここが本質。送り出し機関が海外で高額手数料を取り、監理団体が日本側で監理費を取る「中間搾取」構造。1人あたりトータルで百万円単位の金が動く。

政治的保護: 族議員やNAGOMiなどの関連団体が陳情・後押しをして、問題があっても制度を守りやすくする。

結果: 低賃金労働力が供給され続け、日本人の賃金上昇が抑えられ、失踪や労働基準法違反が構造的に出やすくなる。結果として人口構成も変化する。

2020年以来的教育改革虽然高举“自主性”、“探究”和“因材施教”的旗号，但实际导致的结果却是“只有能学的孩子在进步，学不会的孩子被置之不理”的结构。出于善意而推出的措施，在忽视打牢基础的同时，演变成了“不投入的孩子责任自负”这种偷换概念的局面。

平板电脑的发放就是典型代表。虽然在 GIGA 校园计划下普及了人手一台，但课堂上的有效利用程度因学校和教师而异，不少情况下沦为了单纯的“玩具”，或是被用来刷视频、打游戏。拥有终端设备与思维能力、知识的巩固完全是两码事。如果只是把工具交到手上就要求“自主学习”，基础较差的孩子反而越发迷失方向。

英语难度的提升也极其严峻。小学将英语列为正式科目加上初中词汇量大幅增加（约旧课程的1.5倍），使得从初一阶段开始两极分化就非常显著。在小学阶段没有充分打牢基础的孩子一升入初中立刻跟不上进度，导致大批“厌恶英语”的学生被批量制造出来。平均分也在下降，各地调查中频繁出现“双峰分布”现象。难度增加的结果，仅仅是进一步拉大了能够在家庭中超前学习的阶层与无法做到阶层之间的差距。

“全凭自主性”
items.original:
2020年以降の教育改革は「主体性」「探究」「個別最適」を掲げてきましたが、結果として起きているのは「やれる子だけが伸び、やれない子は放置される」構造です。善意で始めた施策が、基礎の定着を軽視したまま「コミットしない子は自己責任」という形にすり替わっている。

タブレット貸与は象徴的です。GIGAスクールで1人1台を配ったものの、授業での有効活用は学校・教師によって差が大きく、単なる「おもちゃ」や動画視聴・ゲームに使われているケースも少なくない。端末があることと、思考力や知識が定着することは別問題です。道具を渡しただけで「主体的に学べ」と言われても、基礎が弱い子ほど迷子になります。

英語の難化も深刻です。小学校での英語教科化＋中学校での語彙数大幅増加（旧課程の約1.5倍）で、中1の段階から二極化が顕著になっています。小学で十分に定着していない子が中学に上がった瞬間についていけなくなり、「英語嫌い」が量産されている。平均点も下がっており、調査でも「ふたこぶ分布」が各地で報告されています。難しくした分だけ、家庭で先取りできる層とそうでない層の格差が広がっただけです。

「主体性に任せる」「探究重視」も同様です。指導書で「生徒から気づきを！」と書かれていても、知識や手順がなければ気づくこと自体が不可能な内容が少なくない。結果、教師が「教えない」ことが正当化され、コミットしない子はただ放置される。宿題や定期テストを減らす動きも、やらない子を放置しやすくする効果があります。成績公表を控えたり、評価を曖昧にしたりするのも、「できない」ことを見えにくくする方向に働いています。

さらに高校進学が定員割れでほぼノーパスになったことで、中学段階での学習意欲の低下に拍車がかかっている。進学のハードルが下がった分、「やらなくても大丈夫」という空気が強まりやすい。

要するに、基礎をしっかり教えることを「古い」「主体性がない」と軽視し、自己調整や探究に丸投げした結果、家庭の教育力・文化資本がある子だけが勝ち残る構造になっています。これは「ネオゆとり」とも言われますが、実際は「見捨て」の側面が強い。

主体性や探究は大事ですが、それはある程度の知識・技能・習慣が積み上がった上で機能するものです。土台を固めずに「自分で考えろ」と言うのは、指導放棄に近い。現場で苦しんでいる教師・生徒・保護者の声は、もっと真剣に聞くべきだと思います。

ELON MUSK: “We'll be doing our first implants for vision, where even if somebody's completely blind, we can write directly to the visual cortex, and we've had that working in monkeys.

One of our monkeys now has had a visual implant for 3 years, and at first it'll be fairly low resolution, but long term, you'll have very high resolution and be able to see multi-spectral wavelengths, so you could see in infrared, ultraviolet, radar, like a superpower situation.

At some point, the cybernetic implants would not simply be correcting things that went wrong, but augmenting human capabilities dramatically, augmenting intelligence and senses and bandwidth dramatically, and that's going to happen at some point, but digital superintelligence will happen well before that, and at least if we have a neural link, we'll be able to appreciate the AI better.”

《来自一位越南协助者的消息》

有人偷盗他人的宠物狗，并在社交网络上（主要是 Facebook）作为食用肉出售。或许是因为在日本买不到狗肉，这种买卖才能做得起来

在茨城、长野、千叶、群马、滋贺、三重、奈良等地似乎交易非常频繁。
这些情报来自在日本国内认真生活的越南人。

其实在越南国内这也成了一个问题。因为越南战争中南越战败，南越的人们沦为难民避难海外，或者家园土地被没收，大量移民和殖民者从北方涌来。

由于文化、道德观和礼仪规范大相径庭的人们一下子涌入，引发了许多问题

其中之一就是作为宠物饲养的狗被偷去当肉卖的问题

在南越狗是人类的朋友，
但在北越却被当作食材
（北越也有很多人不吃狗肉，我本人也无意指责北越的饮食文化本身）

南越市民和民间企业奋起抵抗，如今新一批来自北越的人们在南越

《あるベトナム人協力者から》

他人のペットの犬を盗み、食肉としてSNS上(主にfacebook)で販売しているんです。日本では犬肉が手に入らないので、このビジネスが成り立つのかもしれません

茨城、長野、千葉、群馬、滋賀、三重、奈良で盛んにやりとりされているみたいです。
日本国内でまじめに暮らしているベトナムの人の人から情報をもらっています。

実はベトナム国内でも問題になっていて、ベトナム戦争で南ベトナムが敗戦した為、南ベトナムの人達は難民となって外国へ避難したり、家や土地をせっしゅされたりして、北側から沢山の移民、植民がやって来ました。

文化やモラル、マナーが大きく異なる人達が一斉に入って来たため沢山の問題が起こりました

その一つがペットとしてら飼われている犬が盗まれ、食肉として売られる問題です

南ベトナムでは人間の友である犬でも、
北ベトナムでは食材として知られています
(北ベトナムでも犬肉を食べれない人は沢山いますし、私自身は北ベトナムの食文化自体を非難しようとは思っていません)

南ベトナムの市民や民間企業などが抵抗して、現在は新たに北ベトナム出身の人たちが南ベトナムで、仕事を探すのは難しくなって来ました

そこで余った労働力に目をつけたのが、日本の経団連や今の日本の与党で、ベトナムで職に就けない人たちを大量に日本に連れて来ています
もちろん頑張って働いているベトナムの人もいますが、職場に馴染めなかったりして結果ドロップアウトして不法滞在となり、トクリュウや犯罪に手を染める人が出て来ます

ベトナム政府は事態を重く見て日本での不法滞在に厳しい姿勢で臨んで一時ベトナム領事館に帰国を望む不法滞在のベトナムが殺到したのですが、このベトナム当局の動きを日本政府が妨害しており不法滞在者が帰国出来ず、逃走してまた不法滞在に戻ってしまっています。

日本政府与党は不法滞在を歓迎優遇する立場をとっており、警察もなかなか動けないのかなと思います

この事件は間接的に経団連、ひいては与党が関わっている為なのか
なかなか日本の方の目に届くことはありませんが、FB上ではベトナム語で沢山飛び交っています。

大好きな日本が日本政府の手で壊されていくのを目の当たりにし、絶望感を感じていますが、協力してくれるベトナムの仲間と情報を共有しています。

もし必要でしたら画像等も送る事が出来ますが、ショッキングなものになります

長文失礼しました

🚨LO FILTRARON EN HORAS

España entera de luto: 69 muertos en Urda. Y poco después del siniestro, los audios del centro de control sonaban en la radio.

¿Quién los filtró? Nadie sabe.
¿Y por qué? Eso sí... y te va a dar mucho asco. Hoy lo entenderás todo. Es de cárcel. Atento.

Ayer el Sindicato Ferroviario puso una denuncia en el juzgado de Orgaz para averiguar quién fue el que filtró los audios.

Y no están solos. CCOO, UGT, SEMAF, CGT y CSIF han dicho lo mismo. En bloque.

¿Por que? 
Querían cargarle el peso del fallo a un operario de Madrid. Eso... ya sabes... exculpa a Óscar Puente (en el punto de mira)... y al gobierno.

MIRA LO QUE DENUNCIAN 
→ Los filtran con la investigación recién abierta. 
→ Señalan a un trabajador de control de Atocha. 
→ Han viralizado su voz en todos los telediarios. 
→ Y ya está en proceso judicial.

El Comité de ADIF le ha escrito a Puente diciéndole que es "absolutamente inadmisible". Que es vender y echar a los leones a una persona.

Y ALGO CLAVE 
Ese sindicato lleva AÑOS escribiendo a ADIF, al ministerio y a la Agencia de Seguridad Ferroviaria.

Como locos, sin parar... ¿Denunciando qué? Falta de personal en centros de control. Sobrecarga. Falta de descansos. Sistemas deficientes.

Todo por escrito.

items.original:
Two million shares of SpaceX moved into escrow today for other people's children.

Gwynne Shotwell, the president of SpaceX, and her husband Robert gave the stock out of their own holdings.

Not the company. THEIRS.

SpaceX went public in June at $135 a share, the biggest stock market debut in history.

The first batch goes to kids aged 11 to 17 living in a ZIP code where the median family income is $57,000 or less. Families get their notice by Monday. The shares land in December.

A Trump Account is the tax favored account the federal government opens for a child, and the $1,000 Washington seeds it with only goes to kids born between January 2025 and December 2028. Every child on this list is too old to have ever qualified. The youngest of them missed that window by a decade.

A second gift is being finalized for children in foster care, children in military families serving overseas, and children in eligible Texas counties under $90,000 a year.

That is not charity. That is ownership. 💎

¿Los animales envenenados de Xochimilco no importan?

En los últimos días, vecinos de la zona chinampera de Xochimilco reportan al menos 60 animales muertos por envenenamiento: 36 perros, 9 gatos, 13 aves silvestres y 2 tlacuaches.

El 23 de octubre, un ciudadano que crea contenido de beatbox denunció a través de su cuenta XolTika que salió en bicicleta con sus dos perros hacia los campos de cempasúchil para tomar fotos.

Los dos perros fueron envenenados, Sloopy murió y Lobito logró sobrevivir después de recibir atención veterinaria.

Después regresó al lugar y encontró una bolsa con restos de pollo y una sustancia de color verde.

Ahí conversó con una persona que trabaja en la zona, quien le explicó con completa naturalidad que encontrar perros envenenados es algo habitual, habló de “como 50 animalitos” y dijo que ponen pollo.

Hablaba de algo que ocurre con frecuencia, ya que los mismos trabajadores de la zona tienen normalizado que mueran animales.

El joven presentó una denuncia ante la Fiscalía CDMX y pidió ayuda para que el caso se conociera y la muerte de Sloopy no quedara impune.

A esto se suman otros reportes de habitantes de San Luis Tlaxialtemalco sobre restos de carne con veneno colocadas en las chinampas para impedir que los perros entren a los cultivos.

La Jornada confirmó que la Fiscalía ya acumulaba denuncias por envenenamientos de perros en la zona chinampera y documentó también los reportes sobre comida con veneno arrojada entre los cultivos.

¿Se está utilizando veneno de manera recurrente para eliminar a los perros y otros animales en Xochimilco?

En plena temporada de cempasúchil, cuando esos mismos campos se promocionan para recibir visitantes, vender flores y tomarse fotografías.

En el Parque España de la alcaldía Cuauhtémoc, hubo policías, Brigada de Vigilancia Animal, Fiscalía, PAOT, revisión de cámaras, comunicados y funcionarios pronunciándose públicamente en cuestión de horas.

En Xochimilco ya se reportan al menos 60 animales muertos y no hemos visto una respuesta comparable.

No hay ruedas de prensa con la Jefa de Gobierno y comitiva.

No vemos autoridades disputándose públicamente quién va a investigar ni explicando qué están haciendo para detener los envenenamientos.

Y la fiscal de la Ciudad de México, Bertha Alcalde, ni siquiera se ha pronunciado públicamente.

No ha explicado cuántas investigaciones existen, si Fiscalía ha recogido los cebos, si se están realizando peritajes, si se recorren las chinampas para localizar más veneno o qué se está haciendo para identificar a quienes lo colocan.

¿Los animales les estorban para la imagen turística y por eso toleran que los estén matando?

¿Por qué, con al menos 60 animales reportados muertos en unos cuantos días, las autoridades no están reaccionando con la misma urgencia?

Xochimilco detrás de su cempasúchil, no puede estar normalizando que maten animales.

items.title:
给你们讲个故事。我们在没有拿到片名所有权的情况下就开拍了，当时不得不准备备选方案。

塔夫脱广播公司拥有《捉鬼敢死队》（Ghostbusters）这个剧名，那是他们旗下一部由拉里·斯托奇和福雷斯特·塔克主演的半小时情景喜剧，里面还有一只追鬼的大猩猩。我此前听都没听说过。他们既没有质子背包，也没有比尔·默里。哥伦比亚影业花了50万美元买下了这个名字，但他们真该把钱付给迪恩·马丁，因为我是最早从他那儿听到这个说法的。

在电影《鬼马两活宝》（1953）中，他和杰瑞·刘易斯
items.original:
Here’s a story for you. We started filming without owning the title and had to do alternates.

Taft Broadcasting owned the title Ghostbusters as part of their half-hour sitcom starring Larry Storch and Forrest Tucker (F-Troop) and a gorilla chasing ghosts. I had never heard of it. They didn’t have proton packs or Bill Murray. Columbia paid $500,000 to buy the name, but they really should have paid Dean Martin, from whom I first heard the term.

In the film Scared Stiff (1953), he and Jerry Lewis (check out his acrobatic stair descent) are in an old haunted castle, and Lizabeth Scott asks Dean: “Who are you guys?” And Dean answers: “You’ve heard of Trustbusters and Gangbusters, we’re Ghostbusters!”

For my research writing the first movie, I watched every single ‘ghost’ comedy ever made. Bowery Boys, Hope and Crosby, Abbot and Costello, Martin and Lewis all did such films.

Happy Halloween 2026.

items.original:
ข้อความชี้แจง

ขอใช้พื้นที่นี้พูดถึงข้อมูลและข้อความเกี่ยวกับตัวผมที่มีการเผยแพร่ในช่วงที่ผ่านมา ซึ่งทำให้เกิดความเข้าใจผิดและส่งผลกระทบต่อความรู้สึกและชื่อเสียงของผม

ผมขอปฏิเสธทุกข้อกล่าวหาที่เกิดขึ้นเกี่ยวกับตัวผม และขอยืนยันว่าข้อกล่าวหาดังกล่าวไม่เป็นความจริง

ผมพร้อมรับฟังความคิดเห็นและคำวิจารณ์ที่อยู่บนพื้นฐานของข้อเท็จจริงเสมอ อย่างไรก็ตาม การนำข้อมูลที่ยังไม่ได้รับการตรวจสอบมาตีความหรือส่งต่อ อาจทำให้เกิดความเสียหายและความเข้าใจผิดเป็นวงกว้างได้

สิ่งที่ผมอยากขอคือการได้รับการพิจารณาอย่างเป็นธรรม และขอให้ทุกคนตรวจสอบข้อมูลอย่างรอบด้านก่อนที่จะเชื่อ ตัดสิน หรือส่งต่อข้อมูลต่อไป

ความเข้าใจผิดที่เกิดขึ้นส่งผลกระทบต่อทั้งความรู้สึก ชื่อเสียง และการใช้ชีวิตของผม จึงอยากขอใช้พื้นที่นี้เพื่อชี้แจงและปกป้องตัวเอง รวมถึงหวังว่าทุกคนจะให้ความสำคัญกับการตรวจสอบข้อมูลและข้อเท็จจริงอย่างรอบด้าน

ทั้งนี้ หากยังคงมีการเผยแพร่ข้อมูลที่ไม่ตรงกับข้อเท็จจริงและก่อให้เกิดความเสียหาย ผมขอพิจารณาดำเนินการตามขั้นตอนที่เหมาะสมต่อไป

ขอบคุณทุกคนครับ

昨晚，由于观点分歧，我与相关各方进行了讨论。虽然我承认确有此事，但我坚决否认任何表明曾使用任何形式的身体暴力来解决任何性质分歧的报道或指控。
items.original:
Following the recent decision from Haas F1 Team confirming that I will not be participating in this weekend’s Mexico City Grand Prix, I wish to formally address some media reports and speculation surrounding the situation.

Last night, a difference in viewpoints led to a discussion with the parties involved. Whilst I acknowledge that this took place, I categorically reject any reports or allegations suggesting that any form of physical violence was used to resolve any differences of any nature.

I strongly condemn violence in all its forms and firmly believe that disagreements should always be handled with professionalism, respect, and mutual understanding.

I kindly ask that speculation be avoided while the matter is being addressed.

items.original:
Slavery was an evil in which people from every continent and region participated. We should be honest about the whole history, not select the parts that are politically convenient today, especially given Britain's leading role in ending the transatlantic slave trade.

If Caribbean countries are asking Britain for a formal apology for Britain’s role in the transatlantic slave trade, will they also be asking the same of the descendants of African kingdoms, rulers and merchants who captured, sold and profited from the trade?

On demands for reparations, whether through cash or debt relief, we have been down this track before. Twenty-five years ago, Jubilee 2000, Drop the Debt and Make Poverty History argued that cancelling the debts of poorer countries would give them a fresh start. More than $100 billion of debt was eventually written off, but many of those countries have since built up even bigger debts. Labour are already spending too much on Britain's welfare state, now is not the time for Andy Burnham to be providing global welfare. 

There is no reason British taxpayers today should be held financially responsible for things that happened generations before any of us were born. And I have even less patience for political elites in commonwealth countries who don’t know how to make their own citizens prosperous now looking for another opportunity to blame Britain.

As Prime Minister, Andy Burnham should be Britain’s greatest defender. Instead, he is writing articles saying we need to confront our history (as if we haven't done enough of that) and considering another formal historical apology. Tony Blair already expressed Britain’s deep sorrow and regret for our role in the slave trade nearly twenty years ago. There is no need to do so again. 

This is all another navel-gazing distraction. The Commonwealth should be looking forward, not endlessly backwards. That means economic partnerships to make us all richer and deeper military and security cooperation against common threats. If every Commonwealth summit becomes an exercise in presenting Britain with demands for cash then we need to start asking if it is worth the effort.

Wyjaśniamy ważne okoliczności tej bulwersującej i skandalicznej sytuacji.

Sędziowie TK czekali na Prezydenta przed wejściem do siedziby TK (bocznym ze wzgl.bezpieczeństwa).
Staliśmy przed drzwiami. Na przodzie grupy sędziów stała STK A. Korwin-Piotrowska, która chciała przywitać Prezydenta i zaprosić do przygotowanej na spotkanie sali.

Nadchodzący energicznie Prezydent nie tylko nie zatrzymał się przed stojącą przed drzwiami Sędzią. Używając najdelikatniejszych słów - Prezydent z impetem wpadł na Sędzię A. Korwin-Piotrowską i zaczął przepychać się przez grupę pozostałych Sędziów.

Podkreślam - nikt Prezydenta nie szarpał, ani nikt z Prezydentem się nie szarpał.

Nagrania, które opublikowaliśmy, nie pokazują całości tej sytuacji. Nagraniami całości dysponują osoby, które szły za Prezydentem i nagrywały całe zdarzenie z tamtej perspektywy.

Co ważne, Prezydent po wejściu do budynku, nie był zainteresowany żadną rozmową. Udał się na piętro budynku z grupą swoich współpracowników.

events.title: Reddit因财报股价暴跌
events.summary:
这不仅是 Reddit 股价的问题，而是整个互联网崩溃的信号啊。
意外地没怎么引起关注，但其实非常严重。

为什么这么说呢，因为以往的互联网是建立在交易机制之上的，网站方让 Google 免费读取内容。
作为交换，Google 从搜索结果中把用户输送回来。这些用户浏览广告，网站得以变现盈利。无论是免费阅读的文章、论坛还是博客，全都建立在这种交换关系之上。

而从现状走向未来的趋势是，像 ChatGPT 或 Claude 这样的工具会去网上搜索并直接给出答案，Google 也开始在搜索界面直接由 AI 作答。
AI 确实读取了内容，但那些省去浏览步骤的用户却不会被输送回来。大概就类似于在书店白看白读的状态。
如果所有人都变成这样会发生什么？书店绝对会倒闭。

Reddit 就是在数据上体现出这一趋势的第一个重大案例，
明明财报显示营收增长 53% 表现强劲，但在给出因来自 Google 的引流减少、预计用户将减少 10% 以上的预期瞬间，股价就暴跌了 29%。
更讽刺的是，Reddit 此前还把自己站内的发帖数据卖给 Google 作为 AI 的训练数据，结果却被自己亲手喂养出来的 AI 抢走了客流

items.title:
不久前在冲绳的一家小吃店吃饭时，有一家带小孩的客人哗啦一下推门走进来。

我定睛一看，当爹的原来看是初中时霸凌过我的学长。

彼此目光撞上，心领神会，我心里还琢磨：“这家伙会以什么态度对待我呢～”。

我本还期待着对方会为往事后悔，跑来向我道歉，结果那家伙：

学长：“哦！真荣田！帮我和家人拍张照！”

居然摆出一副高高在上的样子，一把搂住我的肩膀说道：

我本想当着他家人的面，把至今仍积压心头的怒火发泄出来：

我：“这人初中时霸凌过我。而且，他因为不敢直面自己的罪过，至今都在人前强撑面子，是个无可救药的人”

虽然很想这么说，但觉得孩子和妻子是无辜的，最终作罢了。

而且，看着他的穿着打扮，也能隐约猜出他当下的生活状况，心里不禁有些心酸。

一点都不好笑，讲了个让人心酸的故事，真不好意思。

人果然还是得学会原谅，不然折磨的是自己。

毕竟就算责怪别人，人也不会改变。

2026 年，秋，只是想倾诉给谁听听。

另外，虽然完全无关，内间今天一直把 AI 叫成“au”。

我原谅他了。
items.original:
ちょっと前だけど、沖縄の食堂でメシ食ってたらさ、ガラガラって入って来た親子連れの家族がいてさ。

見たら、親父の方が、中学の時に俺をいじめてた先輩でさ。

お互い目が合って、色々察してさ、俺、「コイツどっちで来るのかな〜」って思ってさ。

昔を悔いて、俺にあやまって来るパターンを期待したんだけど、そいつさ、

先「おう！真栄田！家族と写真撮ってくれ！」って、

って偉そうに、俺にガッて肩組んで言って来てさ、

俺、ついにまだ残ってた、怒りを、家族の前で、

俺「この人は中学の時、俺をいじめてたんですよ。そして、その罪に向き合うのが怖くて今だに強がって人に接するダメな人なんです」って、

言おうと思ったけど、子供や奥さんに罪は無いし言うのやめた。

あと、そいつの身なり見てとら、何となく今の生活も分かって、切なくなってさ。

いっさい笑いも無くせつない話ですみません。

やっぱ人は許さないと自分がきついね。

せめても人は変わらんし。

誰かに言いたくて、2026年、秋。

あと、全く関係無いですが、今日、内間がAIの事をずっと、「au」って言ってました。

許します。

Reddit's earnings call has exposed the new reality for thousands of companies.

"AI mode does not drive traffic. Not for us and not to anybody as far as I know. It used to be a traffic driver. Now it's not." - Reddit CEO.

The reality is that AI is fundamentally changing the way that humans access the internet.

Just 24 hours prior to this statement, Google's stock erased -$480 billion on the same issue: AI is disrupting the traditional search model.

For decades, the internet operated on a simple model. Search engines directed users to websites, and those websites monetized the traffic.

AI is destroying this business model, and it's happening at an accelerating pace.

The traditional model of internet traffic is rapidly becoming outdated.

The internet has entered a new era.

items.title:
如今在 AI 前沿工作的人与基本上其他所有人之间的差距有多大，简直令人难以想象。

疯狂的是，这些轨迹并没有在靠拢，反而渐行渐远。如果 AI 的进步曲线趋于平缓，肯定能让大多数人和企业有时间迎头赶上，或者以标准化的方式落地其工作流。这项技术本会削平竞争优势，因为所有人都会以同样的
items.original:
It’s almost incomprehensible how wide the distance is between someone who’s working at the frontier with AI and basically everyone else right now. 

The crazy thing is these lines are not converging, but only growing farther apart. If the curve of AI progress had leveled off, it would certainly have given most people and companies time to catch up or implement their workflows in a standardized way. The technology would have neutralized competitive advantage because everyone would be using it the same way.

But what’s happened is the opposite. The curve of AI progress is basically going vertical right now, which means if you had codified your processes 3-6 months ago you’re likely already behind again. Now imagine most companies that kicked into gear a year ago and thought that they were done. Even further behind now.

I’ve never seen a technology in my life and career that improves at this rate, which consequently means you need to upgrade your expectations at a similar rate. Our brains weren’t wired for this, and our organizational change management processes certainly weren’t either.

With any form of recursive self improvement, things just get wilder. It’s a time when you will need to be constantly reevaluating the things that didn’t work just a couple months ago to see if they now can be solved. AI native companies certainly have a strong advantage due to this right now, so now it comes down to can the bigger companies keep up. Wild times.

ANTHROPIC 正在严厉打击电子游戏重写 🚨

Claude Code 在 10 月 27 日左右接收了一条新规则，由 Anthropic 的服务器在一个名为“tengu_heron_brook”的标记下下发。没有任何设置可以将其关闭。

完整规则如下：“务必构建原创游戏、特定品类游戏，以及根据用户自身设计和资产构建的游戏。切勿重建某款特定的现有游戏，即使它被重新命名或被称为原创也不行。”

这是游戏重写、MOD 制作以及介于两者之间的一切的终结吗？
items.original:
ANTHROPIC IS CRACKING DOWN ON VIDEO GAME REWRITES 🚨

Claude Code picked up a new rule around Oct 27, sent from Anthropic’s servers under a flag called "tengu_heron_brook". There’s no setting to turn it off.

The full rule: “Do build original games, games in a genre, and games from the user’s own designs and assets. Don’t build a recreation of a specific existing game, even if it is renamed or called original.”

Is this the end of game rewrites, modding and everything in between?

"I don't understand why they're pushing AI so hard when we can all see it's making everything worse."

That's because it's not being marketed to you; it's being marketed to governments and plutocrats. They're the real target audience for these products, not you.

You are not receiving the real sales pitch for AI, because the real sales pitch would not appeal to your sensibilities. The real sales pitch for AI isn't "Hey check out this product, it makes some web searches slightly easier and it can maybe write your emails for you." The real sales pitch for AI is "This product allows you to surveil the entire population of your country. It can be built into autonomous surveillance drones and killing machines. It can allow you to monitor and control every aspect of your society. It can reverse the decentralization of information brought on by the internet age. It can take away the collective bargaining power of workers and give you the skilled services your company requires. It can nullify strikes, civil disobedience, and even full-scale revolutions, and lock humanity into your capitalist dystopia forever."

That's the real sales pitch. It doesn't sound appealing to any normal person, but it makes sense when you remember who these technologies are really being sold to, and why.

我们需要重构并重写大部分软件，以适应一种全新的、更快的节奏。

以往代码是一滴一滴汇聚而来的。很快，甚至可以说现在，代码的编写就会像一条连续的水流，宛如一条汹涌的河流随心所欲地蜿蜒奔腾。

这并不是什么新鲜事：大型科技公司过去凭借庞大规模的工程团队来应对这一点。但现在 AI 为每位工程师都配备了一支极具弹性且能力超群的劳动力。现在轮到你来面对这个问题了，
items.original:
we will need to rebuild and rewrite much of software to adapt to a new, faster pace. 

code used to arrive one drop at a time. soon, if not already, code will be written as if it were a continuous stream, like a violent river twisting and turning as it pleases. 

this is not a new thing: big tech cos have had to deal with this with the enormous scale of their engineering teams. but now ai has brought an incredibly elastic and capable workforce wielded by every engineer. this is your problem now, and the only way to adapt is to evolve your systems so agents - even and especially the ones with little context about the right way of doing things - can thrive. make the easy thing the right thing. 

your codebase is becoming organic architecture. agent contributions grow around the constraints and guardrails you’ve designed. good software engineering matters even more now! and no, the continuous stream of code is not something you have to watch helplessly. be more ambitious and design systems, frameworks, and languages to control the chaos. 

the time for mourning coding is long over

我们的 TPU 刚刚从太空……往家里打电话了。

如果你错过了：10 月 1 日，我们将四块 TPU 送入轨道，以测试我们的 AI 硬件能否在太空中运行。最初的目标是看看我们的芯片能否开机、处理提示词并将回复传回地球。

🚨🚨🚨 Americans, you carry a historic responsibility. 🚨🚨🚨

Not only toward yourselves. Toward the entire world.

Let me explain why.

I'm French. I run an AI company. I live between Paris and San Francisco, so I see both sides of the Atlantic. And I can see what's coming.

We are living through the most consequential civilizational shift in human history. AI is not another tech cycle. Within ten years it will rewrite how we work, how we learn, how we create wealth, and how we decide what is true.

AI can become the greatest instrument of freedom ever built, or the most perfect instrument of control. Same technology. The only difference is who writes the rules.

That is the choice in front of you.

On one side, the world the globalists have been dreaming of for decades. A managed society run by unelected institutions, from Brussels to Davos. Experts deciding what you may say, what you may buy, what counts as true. And now, with AI, the tools to enforce it at scale.

On the other side, a new world, far fairer. Built on reality instead of narratives. Where you can build, speak and trade without asking permission. Where we finally stop building entire systems on lies everyone can see.

If the Democrats take back power, there's a strong chance the first world wins.

How can I be so sure? Because I live in the trailer.

In Europe, the machinery is already built.

The Digital Services Act lets Brussels fine a platform up to 6% of its global revenue for failing to manage "systemic risks" as vague as "negative effects on civic discourse." The first fine ever issued under it went to X. €120 million.

The digital euro: in July, the European Parliament voted 416 to 169 to move it forward. It is now being finalized in closed-door negotiations, with a deal targeted before the end of the year and a launch aimed at 2029. A central bank currency where your financial privacy depends on rules politicians can rewrite later.

Speech under supervision. Money under supervision. Now add an AI that can read everything, everywhere, in real time.

You think it stays in Europe? The DSA already applies to your platforms. And your protection against a digital dollar today? An executive order the next president can erase with one signature, and a ban that passed the House and is still stuck in the Senate.

The Senate. Again.

You have something we don't have in Europe. A man who cannot be bought, because there is nothing left that anyone could offer him. Elon Musk.

Love him or hate him, you know he's authentic. He bought Twitter and gave you your voice back. He has been smeared, boycotted and targeted by every institution that used to own the narrative, and he never bent. He never made a deal with the devil.

When a man like that tells you everything comes down to 51 senators, you listen.

Read his post again. Two new states: four new senators. A bigger Supreme Court: a new majority overnight. Mass legalization: a new electorate. Change the rules of the game once, and you never have to win it again.

That is not a policy agenda. That is an exit from democracy. And once the door is locked from the inside, the European machine crosses the Atlantic. The speech police. The supervised money. The managed truth. All of it running on AI.

Europe was the trailer. Don't let America become the movie.

The entire West is watching you. If America falls, there is nowhere left to go. You are the last country on Earth where an ordinary citizen can still say no, and make it count.

On November 3rd, vote like the free world depends on it.

This time, it does.

$6.3 billion is the biggest in USD terms, but not in BTC terms. MtGox was 650,000 BTC!

Other important numbers to consider:

% of bitcoin (in relation to BTC total supply), ie, market impact. MtGox is big there again at 5%+.

Number of users impacted, and % of user assets impacted. MtGox (the largest CEX at the time) and FTX (not small) were all near 100% of users and their asseets.

Most important: Who is impacted? Does the platform cover it all? (only one victim), as in recent two CEX cases and Binance.

Obviously, still a major disaster for the industry, Binance (and me). It hurts, but we survive. 

Most importantly, we protect our users.

(image from @MatthewRoszak)

Binance has begun recovering affected assets for users and continues to work with law enforcement, issuers, blockchain intelligence firms and industry partners to trace, freeze and recover additional funds.

The company has already publicly committed to cover losses through company funds in the prior announcement.

Binance has already reserved over $6.34B of company funds to cover this incident. $5B of these funds are already held in the exact token assets that were impacted. We are completing the purchase of the remaining amount by buying token assets through market channels and OTC channels. We are doing this to match the format of the remaining token assets and address any asset shortfalls. This step can take longer because some tokens may have low liquidity and OTC settlement also takes time. We will share more progress as soon as we can. 

These figures do not include frozen or protected assets, which remain subject to ongoing recovery and verification. Currently, $3bn has been frozen, with thanks to our industry partners. We are working with partners and law enforcement to recover the frozen assets.We will continue to use company resources to cover confirmed shortfall and will provide further verified updates as recovery efforts progress. Ultimately, all user funds will be verified publicly through our Proof of Reserves.  

We will weather this storm. Thank you for the support.

items.original:
The Binance hacker might have just executed one of the most brilliant moves in crypto.

First, Tether froze $1.5 billion worth of USDT.

Then Circle followed by freezing another $800 million in USDC.

At that point, it seemed like the hacker’s funds were completely trapped.

But apparently, he had already thought several steps ahead.

Rather than keeping the stolen USDT in a wallet, he allegedly deposited it into Aave and used it as collateral to borrow ETH.

Then he walked away.

And this is where things get really interesting.

Tether can freeze the USDT sitting in that wallet.

But it can’t freeze the ETH that was already borrowed.

So now, Aave is left with frozen collateral, while the hacker is holding liquid ETH.

And unless the protocol finds a way to recover those funds, he might not even have to repay the loan.

Two companies froze billions of dollars in seconds.

Yet someone who understood how DeFi works may have found a way to bypass both restrictions.

Pretty wild when you think about it.

items.original:
La investigación inicial de Binance sugiere que el incidente de seguridad podría estar relacionado con la laptop comprometida de un ingeniero de DevOps, lo que le permitió a un atacante acceder a un contenedor de servicio y enviar transacciones de retiro no autorizadas. No encontramos evidencia de ninguna filtración de claves privadas de billeteras. Compartiremos un informe técnico detallado posterior al incidente una vez que la investigación haya finalizado y los hechos se hayan verificado por completo.

El impacto total estimado asciende a aproximadamente 6,300,000,000 USD. Trabajamos con socios de blockchain para congelar los activos afectados y, hasta el momento, se congelaron aproximadamente 3,000,000,000 USD en la cadena.

Binance cubrirá todas las pérdidas con los fondos de SAFU y de la empresa. Los fondos de los usuarios están a salvo. También publicaremos una Prueba de Reservas actualizada una vez que completemos las medidas correctivas.

Como medida de precaución inmediata, Binance:

suspendió temporalmente los depósitos y retiros mientras se completan los controles de seguridad;

revocó la autorización de la dirección afectada;

contactó a las autoridades y a socios de inteligencia de blockchain para rastrear y recuperar los fondos.

Nuestros equipos trabajan sin descanso para resolver este problema de forma segura y exhaustiva. Trabajamos estrechamente con las autoridades para confirmar la identidad de estos delincuentes y llevarlos ante la Justicia.

Confiá únicamente en los canales oficiales de Binance para recibir novedades. Si tenés más preguntas, no dudes en comunicarte con Atención al cliente de Binance.

¡Gracias por tu apoyo!

items.original:
Reading the reconstructed bytecode of the Binance EIP-7702 sweeper (`0x63e8...6fae`) is wild.

This wasn't a generic drainer. It was custom-engineered for Binance 14's architecture:

- Leaves exactly 1 ether behind (`bal - 1 ether`) when sweeping ETH so Binance's automated hot wallet queue wouldn't error on gas and trip alarms.
- Uses raw `staticcall` + `continue` loops with custom error codes (`SweepItemFailed`) so one bricked or blacklisted ERC-20 wouldn't revert the $6B batch.
- Includes a custom `callExecute` function to impersonate Binance 14 as controller of an external vault holding $823M in USDC.

They leave a comment: "robberies could be prevented if getaway cars were slower."

You can't fully blame EIP-7702, but it sped up the attack. Without 7702, draining 64 tokens plus an external $823M vault from a live exchange hot wallet meant fighting moving nonces across 70+ transactions. Defense systems would've killed it after tx #3.

With 7702, Lazarus sprayed 50 consecutive nonces in one type-4 payload, turned an EOA into a custom proxy, and atomically swept billions in a single block.

Ethereum core devs built the ultimate getaway car. Surgical state-sponsored engineering.

This could be etched onchain:
`if (bal > 1 ether) { https://t.co/ou2j9VqGvv{value: bal - 1 ether}(""); }`

分析、监控等都会带来巨大的网站接管风险。如果你使用来自第三方 SaaS 的跟踪脚本，那么一旦他们被黑，黑客就能完全控制你的网站。

这就是今天 Polymarket 瘫痪的原因。他们使用了一个来自跟踪页面加载速度的 SaaS 的微小脚本。那家公司被黑了，黑客随后从 Pol 窃取了数百万
items.original:
I would strongly consider uninstalling any third party js right now if I were you. Especially if it comes from a startup.

Analytics, monitoring, etc are all massive site takeover risks. If you use a tracking script from a third party SaaS, then if they get hacked the hackers have total control over your site too.

This is what took down Polymarket today. They used a tiny script from a SaaS that tracks page load speed. That company got hacked, and the hackers subsequently stole millions from Polymarket users.

If you want to use analytics safely, I would use a product that lets you pin the tracking script and control when it changes. Most of the mature products support this, e.g. Sentry, Amplitude, PostHog, Mixpanel, Heap. If not, you need to trust the company behind it a lot...

Railway got hacked last week. Railway! That's a very competent team, with particularly strong infra chops. The agent swarms are on another level.

A typical analytics company is nowhere near as sophisticated. You should ask yourself: do I trust this company's security more than Railway? I was an analytics CTO in a past life, and I will be the first to admit: we had some great people but we were not on this level.

We (Detail) just uninstalled our session replay, which was a product I loved but is not worth the risk right now.

I hate to write this because I spent a good chunk of my 20s benefitting from product teams taking a chance on a nothing startup and installing our js on their site. But in the past two weeks this risk vector has exploded. It's better for the ecosystem if we move away from third party js as fast as we can.

这并非复杂的逻辑漏洞，而是一次 EIP-7702 委托劫持：

1. 准备阶段：攻击者通过 Tornado Cash 为 0x7c86 提供资金，部署清扫合约（0x63e8），并在外部钱包上进行了三次实盘试跑。
2. 执行阶段：攻击者提交包含 50 个预签名授权（nonce n 到 n+49）的 EIP-7702 批处理，以击中币安 14 号钱包波动的 nonce 窗口。

items.original:
The Binance $5.6B drain is a masterclass in modern EVM exploitation.

It wasn't a complex logic bug. It was an EIP-7702 delegation hijack:

1. Setup: Attacker funds 0x7c86 via Tornado Cash, deploys a sweep contract (0x63e8), and runs three live dry-runs on external wallets.
2. Execution: Attacker submits an EIP-7702 batch with 50 pre-signed authorizations (nonce n to n+49) to hit Binance 14's moving nonce window.
3. One authorization hits. Instantly, Binance 14 (an EOA) is reprogrammed to run the attacker's contract bytecode.
4. Execution looks totally organic: Binance 14 sweeps itself clean. Internal threshold alerts don't trigger because, from the nodes' perspective, the hot wallet is just executing its own transaction.
5. Binance 16 immediately auto-refills 28,000 ETH due to automated treasury rebalance scripts, feeding the exploit loop.

The cold truth: you cannot forge an EIP-7702 delegation list.
For this to execute, the attacker already held the raw private key or unconstrained signing access to Binance 14's HSM/KMS.

But hey, 5.64 billion drained across ETH, BTC, and Tron. 2.54 billion frozen by Tether, Circle, Ripple, and World Liberty within hours.

Code is law until the stablecoin admin keys log in.

Binance got bailed out by the very centralized choke points the cypherpunks warned you about.

Hardware wallets leak your home address.
Centralized exchanges leak the keys to the kingdom.

Self-custody on native, non-delegated chains remains the only honest baseline.

At least you know what to avoid.

في الساعات الأولى من يوم 30 أكتوبر 2026، ضرب زلزال مدمر أسواق العملات الرقمية مع تأكيد تعرض منصة "باينانس" (Binance) لاختراق كارثي. القراصنة لم يكتفوا بثغرة بسيطة، بل تمكنوا من تحويل أصول مسروقة تقدر قيمتها بما لا يقل عن 5.5 مليار دولار، مما يضعنا أمام واحدة من أضخم عمليات السطو الرقمي في التاريخ.

سباق التجميد وغسيل الأموال اللامركزي
بمجرد اكتشاف الكارثة، سارعت الكيانات الكبرى لمحاصرة المهاجم. قامت شركات إصدار العملات المستقرة، وعلى رأسها (Tether) و (Circle)، بتفعيل بروتوكولات الطوارئ وتجميد أكثر من 2 مليار دولار من عملات USDT و USDC المرتبطة بالاختراق. كما تدخل فريق شركة (Ripple) لتجميد حوالي 200 مليون دولار من عملة (RLUSD)، في حين صرحت إدارة "باينانس" أن أموال المستخدمين بأمان.

لكن المهاجم كان متقدماً بخطوة؛ فلتجنب فخ التجميد المبرمج في العقود الذكية للعملات المستقرة، بدأ القراصنة عمليات غسيل أموال واسعة النطاق عبر منصات التبادل اللامركزية (مثل Uniswap) لتحويل العملات المسروقة إلى عملة الإيثريوم (Ether)، مستغلين غياب سلطة مركزية قادرة على تجميد عناوين الإيثريوم.

خطر العدوى: الرعب الحقيقي يضرب الـ DeFi
الخطورة القصوى لهذا الاختراق لا تكمن فقط في السرقة المباشرة، بل في التكتيك الخبيث الذي استخدمه المهاجم لاختراق بروتوكولات الإقراض اللامركزي. بدلاً من مبادلة جميع العملات المستقرة وبيعها، قام المهاجم بإيداع 60 مليون دولار من عملة USDT كضمان (Collateral) في منصة (Aave)، ليقترض مقابلها 19,762 إيثريوم.

هذا التحرك الماكر يهدد بخلق "أزمة ائتمانية" (Credit Crunch) شاملة. فإذا تم تجميد العملات المستقرة المودعة كضمانات، ستعجز بروتوكولات الإقراض عن تسييلها (Liquidation) عند الحاجة، مما يعني انتقال عدوى الانهيار لكامل قطاع التمويل اللامركزي. وحذر الخبراء من أن هذه الخطوة تضع السيولة البديلة للعملات الرقمية (Altcoins) في خطر شديد.

إجراءات الطوارئ وانهيار الأسواق
أمام هذا الخطر الوجودي، انتفضت بروتوكولات الإقراض لحماية نفسها. فرضت منصة (Aave) قيوداً صارمة وحظرت الاقتراض والودائع الجديدة، بينما أوقفت منصة (Kamino) المبنية على شبكة سولانا (Solana) أسواق الإقراض المرتبطة بـ Solana و Bitcoin مؤقتاً كإجراء احترازي.

في هذه الأثناء، تعيش الأسواق حالة من التخبط الملحوظ؛ حيث تراجعت القيمة السوقية الإجمالية للعملات الرقمية بنسبة 5.72%، وارتفعت هيمنة البيتكوين (Bitcoin Dominance) كملاذ أخير. وتُشير التوقعات إلى مسار هبوطي سلبي على المدى القصير والمتوسط، فإذا لم يتم احتواء تداعيات الأصول المجمدة والضمانات المعلقة، فإن قطاع الكريبتو بأكمله يقف على أعتاب أزمة ثقة خانقة قد تطول لفترة غير معلومة.

The timing of today's market crash is noteworthy.

As selling pressure spreads, the Nasdaq 100 is now down nearly -5% on the day.

Meanwhile, the market-implied odds of a Democrat "sweep" in the Midterms next week has surged from 65% to 72% today, a record high.

That's +7 percentage points in 2 days amid this market downturn.

We have yet to receive a comment from the Trump Administration regarding the current situation in the market.

However, what is clear is that the timing of today's market crash will be consequential.

And, even as technology stocks drop sharply, US Treasury Yields are barely seeing any relief.

This leaves us with high rates, a falling stock market, $100+ oil prices, and rising CPI, PPI, and PCE inflation.

Next week is going to be interesting, to say the least.

items.original:
I am sorry to say, Madam Finance Minister, this is utter nonsense. 

Instead of lecturing us about the past, you must tell us what urgency led the government to sell such a major asset at 14% below the original reserve price at a time when:

1. India's stock market is one of the worst-performing of all 47 countries in the MSCI.
2. Foreign ownership of Indian equities is at an about a 15-year low.
3. The RBI is intervening heavily (tens of billions of dollars) to defend the rupee.

Why sell in this environment? What is the government not telling us? There is extensive literature on the need to assess market conditions in choosing the method and timing of privatization. Besides, what message does this send to investors for future strategic sales?

Deflecting from legitimate concerns about this truly astonishing deal is not acceptable to the people. The opposition has every right to ask you basic questions about our national assets.

Governo Lula firma contrato para preparar privatização dos Correios

Escritório receberá R$7,097 milhões para examinar a entrada de acionistas privados na estatal, enquanto a direção enfrenta greves e põe patrimônio à venda
PUBLICADO EM: 30/10/2026

Os Correios firmaram um contrato de R$7,097 milhões com o escritório Pinheiro Neto que inclui a preparação de sua transformação em sociedade de economia mista e de uma possível oferta de ações na Bolsa. A informação, publicada por O Globo em 23 de outubro, mostra a direção da estatal trabalhando para permitir a entrada de capital privado. Ainda não há decisão de vender ações, mas o governo já encomendou o serviço jurídico para examinar essa operação.

A lista de dezessete serviços inclui estudar a necessidade de autorização do Congresso, definir a estrutura societária, preparar o registro de companhia aberta, auxiliar potenciais compradores e redigir contratos de venda de ações. A contratação ocorreu sem licitação, segundo O Globo.

Numa sociedade de economia mista, a União pode manter a maioria das ações com direito a voto. Investidores privados receberiam parte dos resultados. É uma concessão aos capitalistas dentro de um serviço público construído com recursos nacionais. O plano examina ainda parcerias e venda de ativos: pedaços da estatal podem ser entregues sem tirar o nome do governo da porta. Trata-se de um eufemismo para privatização.

A direção invoca prejuízos de R$8,5 bilhões em 2025 e de cerca de R$5,5 bilhões no primeiro semestre de 2026. Em abril, contratou a consultoria McKinsey. Agora vieram os advogados. Também negocia R$7 bilhões em novos empréstimos com bancos, após contrair R$12 bilhões no fim de 2025. Para os trabalhadores dos Correios, a resposta à crise tem sido cortar direitos e postos de trabalho.

O ministro da Fazenda, o neoliberal Dario Durigan, já havia anunciado a escolha do governo. Em entrevista à GloboNews, em agosto, declarou: “Eu não tenho dilema em discutir segmentar atividades dos Correios, fazer com que você tenha mais joint ventures, ou seja, parcerias com a iniciativa privada”. Falou também em usar empréstimos para financiar investimentos, “alienação de ativos e parcerias com a iniciativa privada”. Primeiro o ministro propôs dividir as atividades da estatal com grupos particulares. Agora a direção paga para saber como abrir seu capital.

A alienação de patrimônio já foi tentada no Rio de Janeiro. A antiga sede nacional dos Correios, construída em 1878 na Rua Primeiro de Março, foi posta em leilão este ano por R$53,6 milhões. O edifício ocupa um quarteirão perto da Praça XV e faz parte de um conjunto histórico tombado. No leilão de 22 de outubro, porém, não houve ofertas: o prédio não foi vendido. Apesar disso, a decisão de pô-lo à disposição dos compradores permanece.

Em 2023, Lula retirou os Correios do Programa Nacional de Desestatização, no qual Bolsonaro havia incluído a estatal. Mas o decreto não impediu a empresa do governo de leiloar imóveis, procurar sócios privados e encomendar estudos para vender ações. Mesmo com o governo formalmente no comando, serviços e receitas podem ser transferidos a particulares.

Os ataques são anteriores a Bolsonaro. Aliás, eles são um método tradicional do próprio presidente Lula. Em 2008, no segundo mandato de Lula, um novo Plano de Cargos, Carreiras e Salários extinguiu o cargo de motorista e reuniu funções distintas sob a denominação de agente de Correios. A mudança facilitou a terceirização. Setores da direita permaneceram na direção da empresa, enquanto sindicalistas do PT e do PCdoB passaram à administração patronal.

Naquele mesmo ano, uma greve de carteiros alcançou mais de vinte estados. Os empregados cobravam o pagamento permanente de um adicional salarial. A direção dos Correios pediu ao Tribunal Superior do Trabalho que suspendesse a paralisação; como alternativa, exigiu que 70% do pessoal continuasse trabalhando, sob ameaça de multa de R$100 mil à Fentect. Os grevistas conquistaram o adicional de 30%, mas tiveram de compensar as horas paradas. Foi assim que o governo do antigo dirigente sindical tratou os funcionários que cruzaram os braços.

Em setembro de 2009, 27 dos 35 sindicatos da categoria recusaram uma proposta de acordo que valeria por dois anos e mantiveram a greve. A estatal voltou a recorrer ao TST. Lula criticou publicamente as lideranças do movimento e advertiu os empregados de que poderiam perder salário com o desconto dos dias parados. Sua administração tentava conter a mobilização justamente quando os trabalhadores exigiam reajuste, contratações e melhores condições de serviço.

A ofensiva não terminou com os mandatos anteriores. Em dezembro de 2025, já sob o atual governo Lula, uma greve por salários e direitos levou novamente os Correios ao TST. O tribunal determinou que 80% dos empregados permanecessem em serviço em cada unidade e fixou multa diária de R$100 mil aos sindicatos. Em janeiro de 2026, a direção da empresa obteve no STF a suspensão do abono de fim de ano, da gratificação de férias e de outras cláusulas trabalhistas. Em setembro, diante de outra greve contra mudanças no plano de saúde, a empresa recorreu mais uma vez à Justiça, que impôs a manutenção de 80% do efetivo.

Os Correios alcançam localidades onde uma transportadora privada não manteria atendimento regular por falta de lucro. Essa rede pode distribuir livros, medicamentos e mercadorias, integrar o território e apoiar o desenvolvimento nacional. Precisa de investimentos, concursos e recuperação dos serviços entregues a terceiros.

Durigan já indicou o que se pode esperar do novo governo Lula: mais participação privada, venda de patrimônio e contenção de despesas imposta à empresa. Vai trabalhar pela privatização total dos Correios. Aos empregados que resistem, a direção responde com pedidos ao TST.

Os trabalhadores dos Correios precisam organizar suas bases, unir os sindicatos e enfrentar cada retirada de direito e cada passo de privatização. A luta deve exigir a reestatização completa da empresa, sob controle dos trabalhadores, e a ampliação dos serviços públicos dos Correios em todo o País.
